title: Update frontend to consume renamed balances.pairwise field
declaredInterface: No new interface - frontend now reads `balances.pairwise` instead of the removed `balances.settlements`, matching the backend's GET /balances response shape after the pairwise-balances change.
assumptions: Backend GET /balances was just changed (by me, this session) to return {net, pairwise} instead of {net, settlements}. The frontend (just pushed by a teammate) still references `settlements` in 3 files, which would silently break the Settle Up view. Fixing references only, not changing any UI/UX behavior.
